sound_engine: eSpeak NG 1.51 phonetic examples; synthetic, not pronunciation assessment. Isolated English r uses sustained r-; isolated stops include release pause.

items.text: Mia puts her cup on the table.
The book hides the cup. Where is it?
Mia moves the book. There is the cup!
Mia holds her cup and smiles.
أَمْسَكَ عُمَرُ الْكُرَةَ. انْتَظَرَتْ لَيْلَى دَوْرَهَا.
Sam holds the ball. Mia waits for her turn.
Sam rolls the ball to Mia.
أَعَادَتْ لَيْلَى الْكُرَةَ إِلَى عُمَرَ. لَعِبَا مَعًا.
Mia rolls the ball back to Sam. They play together.
A cat stands beside an open box.
The cat gets into the box by itself.
The cat steps out and sits beside the box.
وَضَعَ عُمَرُ غِطَاءً نَاعِمًا فِي الصُّنْدُوقِ. بَقِيَتِ الْقِطَّةُ حُرَّةً.
Sam puts a soft blanket in the open box. The cat can choose.
Sam stands by a closed door.
Dad opens the door and welcomes Sam.
دَخَلَ عُمَرُ مَعَ أَبِيهِ، وَحَكَى مَا فَعَلَ.
Sam walks in with Dad and tells his story.
First, Mia has a cup and a book.
Next, the book hides the cup.
Then Mia moves the book and finds the cup.
Last, Mia holds the cup and smiles.
The cat is outside the box.
وَضَعَ الوَلَدُ غِطَاءً نَاعِمًا فِي الصُّنْدُوقِ.
Sam puts a soft blanket in the box.
I can see the cup beside the book.
The upright book hides the cup.
هَذَا هُوَ الدَّلِيلُ: اِبْتَعَدَ الكِتَابُ فَظَهَرَ الكُوبُ.
Here is a clue: move the book, and the cup appears.
وَجَدَتْ لَيْلَى مَا كَانَتْ تَبْحَثُ عَنْهُ.
Mia has found what she was looking for.
The girl rolls the ball back.
An empty box sits beside the cat.
The cat chooses to climb inside.
The cat walks out. The box stays open.
أَصْبَحَ دَاخِلُ الصُّنْدُوقِ نَاعِمًا. مَاذَا قَدْ يَخْتَارُ القِطُّ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ؟
Now the box has a soft blanket. What might the cat choose next?
Sam waits until the door opens.
حَيَّا عُمَرُ مَنْ فِي الدَّاخِلِ، ثُمَّ دَخَلَ.
Sam says hello, then steps inside.
Mia puts a seed in the soil.
After several days, little leaves appear.
With care and time, the plant grows.
بَدَأَتْ رِحْلَةُ النَّبَاتِ بِبَذْرَةٍ فِي التُّرْبَةِ.
The plant journey begins with a seed in soil.
وَضَعَتْ نُورَا الْوِعَاءَ قُرْبَ الضَّوْءِ، وَسَقَتْهُ بِرِفْقٍ.
Mia puts the pot near the light and waters gently.
اِنْتَظَرَتْ أَيَّامًا، ثُمَّ رَأَتْ نَبْتَةً صَغِيرَةً.
She waits several days, then sees a little plant.
She keeps caring for it, and the plant grows.
قَالَتْ نُورَا: أَرَى بَذْرَةً، وَأَتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ تَنْبُتَ.
Mia says, I see a seed, and I think it will sprout.
أَعْطَتْهَا مَاءً بِرِفْقٍ وَتَرَكَتْهَا قُرْبَ الضَّوْءِ.
She waters gently and leaves the pot near the light.
بَعْدَ أَيَّامٍ، صَارَتِ الْأَوْرَاقُ دَلِيلًا تَرَاهُ.
Several days later, the leaves are a clue she can see.
لَمْ يَكْبَرِ النَّبَاتُ فَوْرًا؛ اِلْعِنَايَةُ وَالْوَقْتُ جُزْءٌ مِنَ الْحِكَايَةِ.
The plant does not grow at once. Care and time are part of the story.
Mia has a toy car and wooden blocks.
She makes a little bridge, but it is crooked.
She moves the blocks, and the bridge is level.
The toy car crosses the bridge.
اِخْتَارَتْ نُورَا مُكَعَّبَاتٍ وَقِطْعَةً خَشَبِيَّةً لِجِسْرِهَا.
Mia chooses blocks and a wooden plank for her bridge.
لَاحَظَتْ أَنَّ الْقِطْعَةَ مَائِلَةٌ، فَأَبْقَتِ السَّيَّارَةَ تَنْتَظِرُ.
She notices the plank is tilted and keeps the car waiting.
She moves the supports closer and lines them up.
The bridge is level, and her toy car crosses.
Mia imagines a bridge for her red toy car.
الْجِسْرُ مَائِلٌ؛ هَذَا شَيْءٌ تَرَاهُ، وَلَيْسَ حُكْمًا عَلَى مُحَاوَلَتِهَا.
The plank is tilted. That is something she sees, not a score for her try.
عَدَّلَتْ مَكَانَ الْمُكَعَّبَاتِ لِتَخْتَبِرَ فِكْرَةً جَدِيدَةً.
She changes the blocks to test a new idea.
عَبَرَتِ السَّيَّارَةُ؛ هَذَا دَلِيلٌ أَنَّ الْجِسْرَ نَاسَبَ لُعْبَتَهَا.
The car crosses. That is a clue that the bridge works for her toy.
أَمَامَ نُورَا لَوْنٌ أَحْمَرُ وَلَوْنٌ أَصْفَرُ.
Mia has red paint and yellow paint.
Mia mixes the paints with a brush.
جَهَّزَتْ نُورَا وَرَقَةً وَأَلْوَانًا قَابِلَةً لِلْغَسْلِ.
Mia gets paper and washable paints ready.
She stirs red and yellow together.
نَظَرَتْ إِلَى اللَّوْنِ الْجَدِيدِ قَبْلَ الرَّسْمِ.
She looks at the new color before painting.
She uses orange to paint a flower.
تَرَى نُورَا لَوْنَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْمَزْجِ: أَحْمَرَ وَأَصْفَرَ.
Mia sees two colors before mixing: red and yellow.
She mixes them and watches what changes.
She says, I see orange after the mixing.
اِخْتَارَتْ زَهْرَةً لِتَسْتَخْدِمَ فِيهَا اللَّوْنَ الْجَدِيدَ.
She chooses a flower for her new color.
Mia is missing a picture piece.
Sam offers the piece to his friend.
Mia puts the piece in its place.
The picture is complete, and the friends smile.
Mia notices the gap in the picture.
Sam has the piece and offers it.
Mia fits the piece into the gap.
The puzzle is complete with both friends helping.
رَأَتْ نُورَا الْفَرَاغَ. يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تَقُولَ: هَلْ تُسَاعِدُنِي؟
Mia sees the gap. She could say, Can you help me?
قَدَّمَ عُمَرُ الْقِطْعَةَ. يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَقُولَ: تَفَضَّلِي.
Sam offers the piece. He could say, Here you are.
رَكَّبَتْهَا نُورَا. يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تَقُولَ: شُكْرًا لَكَ.
Mia fits it in. She could say, Thank you.
نَرَى صُورَةً كَامِلَةً؛ وَيُمْكِنُنَا تَأْلِيفُ حِوَارٍ لِلصَّدِيقَيْنِ.
We see a finished picture. We can make a conversation for the friends.
Mia has socks in different colors.
She finds two matching blue socks.
She puts the pairs in the basket.
Mia gathers the socks near the basket.
نَظَرَتْ إِلَى اللَّوْنِ وَالشَّكْلِ لِتَجِدَ الزَّوْجَ.
She looks at color and shape to find a pair.
She keeps each pair together and folds it.
The socks are tidy in the basket.
Mia sees blue socks and orange socks.
She uses color and shape as clues for matching.
She finds a pair, then folds it.
تَضَعُ الْأَزْوَاجَ فِي مَكَانٍ وَاحِدٍ لِتَجِدَهَا لَاحِقًا.
She puts the pairs in one place to find them later.
Mia draws a sun on a card.
She puts the card in an envelope.
She gives the envelope to her friend Sam.
Sam opens it and sees the sun.
Mia chooses a sun for her picture message.
She keeps the drawing inside an envelope.
She gives the message to Sam by hand.
ظَهَرَتِ الرَّسْمَةُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ عِنْدَمَا فَتَحَ عُمَرُ الظَّرْفَ.
The drawing appears again when Sam opens the envelope.
رَسَمَتْ نُورَا شَمْسًا. نَرَى الرَّسْمَةَ، وَلَا نَعْرِفُ كُلَّ أَفْكَارِهَا.
Mia draws a sun. We see her drawing, but we do not know all her thoughts.
تَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ تُرْسِلَ رَسْمَتَهَا دُونَ كَلِمَاتٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ.
She can send a drawing without written words.
قَدَّمَتْهَا لِعُمَرَ. يُمْكِنُنَا تَخَيُّلُ مَا قَالَتْهُ.
She gives it to Sam. We can imagine what she says.
رَأَى عُمَرُ الشَّمْسَ. مَاذَا يُمْكِنُ أَنْ يَقُولَ فِي حِوَارِنَا؟
Sam sees the sun. What could he say in our conversation?
Mia sees clouds through the window.
نَزَلَ الْمَطَرُ، فَجَهَّزَتِ الْحِذَاءَ وَالْمِظَلَّةَ مَعَ أُمِّهَا.
Rain begins. Mia and Mom get boots and an umbrella ready.
She walks with Mom under the umbrella.
They return and leave the boots and umbrella to dry.
نَظَرَتْ نُورَا إِلَى الْغُيُومِ قَبْلَ الْخُرُوجِ.
Mia looks at the clouds before going out.
مَعَ نُزُولِ الْمَطَرِ، جَهَّزَتْ أَشْيَاءَ تُنَاسِبُهُ مَعَ أُمِّهَا.
When rain starts, she and Mom prepare things for rain.
Mom holds the umbrella, and they walk together.
بَعْدَ الرُّجُوعِ، رَتَّبَتَا الْأَشْيَاءَ الْمُبْتَلَّةَ لِتَجِفَّ.
Back home, they put the wet things where they can dry.
الْغُيُومُ شَيْءٌ تَرَاهُ نُورَا؛ قَدْ تَتَوَقَّعُ الْمَطَرَ.
Clouds are something Mia sees. She may predict rain.
الْقَطَرَاتُ عَلَى النَّافِذَةِ دَلِيلٌ أَنَّ الْمَطَرَ بَدَأَ.
Drops on the window are a clue that rain has started.
She chooses an umbrella and goes out with Mom.
بَعْدَ الْعَوْدَةِ، تَرَكَتَا الْمِظَلَّةَ وَالْحِذَاءَ لِتَجِفَّ.
After returning, they leave the umbrella and boots to dry.
Mia has an open, empty bag.
She chooses a book, crayons and a water bottle.
She puts them in the bag and closes it.
تَقِفُ بِحَقِيبَتِهَا مَعَ أُمِّهَا قُرْبَ الْبَابِ.
She stands with her bag and Mom by the door.
Mia has objects and an empty bag in front of her.
اِخْتَارَتْ مَا تَحْتَاجُهُ لِنَشَاطِهَا، وَتَرَكَتِ الْكُرَةَ.
She chooses what she needs for her activity and leaves the ball.
She carefully puts the chosen things inside.
She is ready to go out with Mom.
تَنْظُرُ نُورَا إِلَى الْأَشْيَاءِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَمْلَأَ حَقِيبَتَهَا.
Mia looks at the objects before filling her bag.
تُفَكِّرُ فِي نَشَاطِهَا، فَتَخْتَارُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْأَلْوَانَ وَالْمَاءَ.
She thinks about her activity and chooses the book, crayons and water.
She arranges her choices and closes the bag.
تَقِفُ مَعَ أُمِّهَا، وَحَقِيبَتُهَا الْخَفِيفَةُ جَاهِزَةٌ.
She stands with Mom, and her light bag is ready.
The fruit is ready, and the basket is nearby.
تَضَعُ نُورَا الْفَاكِهَةَ وَالْأَطْبَاقَ فِي السَّلَّةِ.
Mia puts fruit and plates in the basket.
تَفْرُدُ الْبِسَاطَ مَعَ أُمِّهَا تَحْتَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
She and Mom spread the mat under the tree.
The family sits and shares the fruit.
Mom gets the fruit ready for the picnic.
سَاعَدَتْ نُورَا فِي وَضْعِ الْأَشْيَاءِ فِي السَّلَّةِ.
Mia helps put the things in the basket.
They spread the mat in the garden.
The family shares fruit on the mat.
نَرَى فَاكِهَةً مُجَهَّزَةً؛ الْأُمُّ وَنُورَا تَسْتَعِدَّانِ.
We see prepared fruit. Mom and Mia are getting ready.
Mia takes part by arranging the picnic things.
تُسَاعِدُ فِي فَرْدِ الْبِسَاطِ، وَأُمُّهَا مَعَهَا.
She helps spread the mat with Mom beside her.
تَجْتَمِعُ الْعَائِلَةُ. يُمْكِنُ أَنْ نَحْكِي مَا فَعَلَهُ كُلُّ شَخْصٍ.
The family gathers. We can tell what each person did.
Mia has a sheet of paper on the table.
She folds the paper with Mom.
The paper becomes a little boat.
تُجَرِّبُ الْقَارِبَ مَعَ أُمِّهَا فِي وِعَاءٍ بِقَلِيلٍ مِنَ الْمَاءِ.
She tries the boat with Mom in a basin with a little water.
Mia gets paper ready for her idea.
Mom helps her with the folding.
They put the finished boat on the table.
جَرَّبَتَاهُ مَعًا فِي وِعَاءٍ ضَحْلٍ بِقَلِيلٍ مِنَ الْمَاءِ.
Together, they try it in a shallow basin with a little water.
تَرَى نُورَا وَرَقَةً مُسَطَّحَةً قَبْلَ الطَّيِّ.
Mia sees flat paper before folding.
She changes its shape with Mom’s help.
تَقُولُ: أَرَى قَارِبًا، وَأَتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ يَطْفُوَ.
She says, I see a boat, and I think it will float.
تَرَاهُ يَطْفُو فِي الْوِعَاءِ. هَذِهِ مُلَاحَظَةٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ التَّجْرِبَةِ.
She sees it float in the basin. This is an observation from this try.
أَيُّ نِهَايَةٍ تُحَافِظُ عَلَى حُرِّيَّةِ الْقِطَّةِ؟
Who catches the ball after Sam?
How does Sam ask Dad to open the door?
Where is the cat in the second picture?
What does Sam do for his friend?
Which ending gives the cat a choice?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ يَظْهَرُ فِيهَا الْكُوبُ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ؟
Which picture shows the cup again?
أَيْنَ الصُّورَةُ الَّتِي فِيهَا الْقِطُّ دَاخِلَ الصُّنْدُوقِ؟
Which picture shows the cat inside?
مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ الْبِنْتُ عِنْدَمَا تَصِلُهَا الْكُرَةُ؟
What does the girl do when the ball reaches her?
مَا الَّذِي أَضَافَهُ الْوَلَدُ إِلَى الصُّنْدُوقِ؟
What does Sam add to the box?
Which picture comes before going inside?
Where do the little leaves appear?
Which picture shows care with water?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُعْطِينَا دَلِيلًا أَنَّ الْبَذْرَةَ نَبَتَتْ؟
Which picture gives a clue that the seed has sprouted?
Where is the car on the bridge?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ أَصْلَحَتْ نُورَا الْجِسْرَ؟
Which picture shows how Mia fixes the bridge?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُعْطِينَا دَلِيلًا أَنَّ جِسْرَ اللُّعْبَةِ يَعْمَلُ؟
Which picture gives a clue that the toy bridge works?
Which picture shows the paints mixing?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ اللَّوْنَ الْجَدِيدَ قَبْلَ رَسْمِ الزَّهْرَةِ؟
Which picture shows the new color before the flower is painted?
Where does Sam offer the piece?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ كَيْفَ اخْتَفَى الْفَرَاغُ؟
Which picture shows how the gap is filled?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُنَاسِبُ قَوْلَ: تَفَضَّلْ هَذِهِ الْقِطْعَةَ؟
Which picture fits the words, Here is the piece?
أَيْنَ الْجَوْرَبَانِ الْأَزْرَقَانِ جَنْبًا إِلَى جَنْبٍ؟
Where are the blue socks side by side?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ الطَّيَّ بَعْدَ الْمُطَابَقَةِ؟
Which picture shows folding after matching?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُظْهِرُ دَلِيلَ التَّشَابُهِ قَبْلَ الطَّيِّ؟
Which picture shows the matching clue before folding?
Where is the sun being drawn?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ أَنَّ الرِّسَالَةَ وَصَلَتْ إِلَى الصَّدِيقِ؟
Which picture shows the message reaching the friend?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُعْطِينَا دَلِيلًا أَنَّ الصَّدِيقَ رَأَى الرَّسْمَةَ؟
Which picture gives a clue that the friend has seen the drawing?
Where does Mia walk under the umbrella?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ الِاسْتِعْدَادَ قَبْلَ الْمَشْيِ؟
Which picture shows getting ready before walking?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ فِيهَا دَلِيلٌ مُبَاشِرٌ أَنَّ الْمَطَرَ بَدَأَ؟
Which picture has a direct clue that rain has started?
Where is the ready bag on Mia’s back?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ الِاخْتِيَارَ قَبْلَ وَضْعِ الْأَشْيَاءِ؟
Which picture shows choosing before packing?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُعْطِينَا دَلِيلًا أَنَّهَا انْتَهَتْ مِنَ التَّجْهِيزِ؟
Which picture gives a clue that packing is finished?
Where does the family sit together?
Which picture shows packing the basket?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ فِيهَا نُورَا تُشَارِكُ فِي إِعْدَادِ مَكَانِ الْجُلُوسِ؟
Which picture shows Mia helping prepare the place to sit?
أَيْنَ الْقَارِبُ الْوَرَقِيُّ جَاهِزٌ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ؟
Where is the finished paper boat on the table?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُبَيِّنُ الطَّيَّ بِمُسَاعَدَةِ الْمُرَافِقِ؟
Which picture shows folding with a companion’s help?
أَيُّ صُورَةٍ تُعْطِينَا دَلِيلًا أَنَّ الْقَارِبَ يَطْفُو فِي هَذِهِ التَّجْرِبَةِ؟
Which picture gives a clue that this boat floats in this try?
